US Prosecutor Declines to Challenge Dropping of Gautam Adani Case

A top US prosecutor has decided not to challenge the Department of Justice's decision to drop a criminal case against Gautam Adani and others. The case, reportedly involving allegations of bribery, was dismissed after the DOJ stated it was brought without a realistic prospect of trial. Adani has denied any wrongdoing or that a US investment plan influenced the decision.
